missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend a multivitamin automatically; identify likely dietary gaps and reconcile current products first.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim a multivitamin replaces a varied diet or prevents chronic disease.
Do not infer a specific nutrient deficiency from a broad dietary-gap response.
Do not duplicate nutrients across products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, diagnosed deficiency, malabsorption, chronic disease, restrictive eating disorder or medically prescribed supplementation.
population_and_context: People reporting dietary gaps; a multivitamin/mineral may increase intake but product choice depends on actual dietary pattern, life stage and existing products.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Compare each product nutrient with life-stage reference intakes and upper limits; avoid unnecessary high-dose formulations.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral fact sheet describes formulation variability and limitations in evidence for broad outcomes. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
